name: 08057 · Moorestown, NJ
findings: ZIP 08057 (Moorestown) has 149 nonprofit organizations. 68 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (29% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 08057 (Moorestown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
40% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 08057 (Moorestown) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 39 organizations here; 49% of all organizations here have no identified type.
